firstMismatch.message: unsupported hero command: an unported branch of this command: the options menu requires reset_customsymbols()

summary: The options menu changes the customsymbols setting and sets go.opt_reset_customsymbols. C then calls utf8map.c:reset_customsymbols() before redrawing the map. JavaScript stops at the option key because reset_needed_visuals() still throws for that call.

source.branch: With ENHANCED_SYMBOLS enabled, options.c:optfn_boolean() sets go.opt_reset_customsymbols when the customsymbols option changes. options.c:reset_needed_visuals() calls reset_customsymbols() before docrt(); reset_customsymbols() clears every glyph's Unicode representation, clears the corresponding cached references, and reapplies symbol customizations for gc.currentgraphics.
callers: options.c:reset_needed_visuals() consumes go.opt_reset_customsymbols and calls reset_customsymbols() before docrt().
options.c:doset() and doset_simple() call reset_needed_visuals() after an option selection.

evidence: The v65 queue entry and the recorded session identify step 8 as the first mismatch. The preceding inputs open the options menu and move to its Map page; key d selects customsymbols.
Upstream options.c:optfn_boolean() sets go.opt_reset_customsymbols for opt_customsymbols. options.c:reset_needed_visuals() then calls utf8map.c:reset_customsymbols() and docrt() in that order.

Upstream utf8map.c:free_all_glyphmap_u() clears glyphmap[glyph].u and each gg.gbuf[y][x].glyphinfo.gm.u reference. reset_customsymbols() calls that helper, then calls apply_customizations(gc.currentgraphics, do_custom_symbols).

JavaScript js/options.js:reset_needed_visuals() currently throws UnsupportedOptionMenuError('reset_customsymbols()') instead of calling the C behavior. A fresh differential of the admitted v65 recipe matched all 2378 RNG calls, but stopped after C produced 10 screens and JavaScript produced 8; the first missing boundary followed key d. The log is .cache/C-customsymbols-target-fresh.log.
The neighboring v65 customcolors case exercises glyphs.c:reset_customcolors(), which clears and reapplies color overrides. It does not cover utf8map.c's Unicode-symbol reset path.
